QuestInfo.name: In the Shadows of Jianghu
QuestInfo.2:
Feng talked about the Devil Clan that was supposedly destroyed decades ago. Through violent spells and overwhelming power, they caused bloodshed all across Jianghu. 
Their scattered remnants have been spotted here and there recently, and Feng suspects that they destroyed the Xuanshan School. 

If the visions you've seen are indeed your past memories, that could mean that you were once the leader of the Devil Clan. If that is true, does that mean your power is inherently evil?
